senses.zh_definition: 英语人名或姓氏 Travis，常音译为“特拉维斯”；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An English given name or surname, normally capitalized Travis.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya nama lelaki atau nama keluarga, yang ditulis sebagai Travis.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 表示专有名词，不是马来语普通名词。不能把姓名词源直接当成人物名称的现代词义。以下是姓名的句法用例，并非固定词汇搭配；马来语释义为编写性说明。[Behind the Name：Travis](https://www.behindthename.com/name/travis)

etymology.historical_story: Travis developed as a given name from an English surname associated with Old French traverser, meaning to cross. Behind the Name also records American use in honour of William Travis, the Alamo commander. This history explains the name's background; a person called Travis is not thereby being described as someone who crosses. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/travis)
